labels.pairing_fallback: Fill with products from the same collection when none are chosen

labels.free_delivery_threshold: Free delivery from (amount in the store currency)

info.announcement: Keep it short: two or three messages work best.
info.arabic_fonts: Most library fonts do not include Arabic letters. Arabic text automatically uses a matching system font.
info.card_sizes: Lists the values of the size option and strikes through the ones that are out of stock.
info.colour_bar: Turns the colour filter into a row of swatch links above the grid. Needs a colour filter in the Search and Discovery app.
info.complementary: Products are set in the Search and Discovery app.
info.contrast: Keep text and background contrast at 4.5:1 or higher so everyone can read your store.
info.credit: The "Theme by ZeronKit" credit can be switched off in Theme settings, Theme credit.
info.credit_setting: A small thank you link to the free theme's maker. Switch it off any time.
info.custom_liquid: Add app snippets or other Liquid code.
info.dynamic_checkout: Shows payment buttons such as Shop Pay. Set them up in your payment settings.
info.favicon: Shown in browser tabs. Use a square image of 32 x 32 px.
info.featured_media: Images, videos and 3D models of the chosen product.
info.filters: Set up filters in the Search and Discovery app.
info.follow_on_shop: Needs Shop Pay to be turned on.
info.frame_label: Small vertical label at the edge of the image, like a frame number on a film roll.
info.gradient: Optional. Replaces the solid background where supported.
info.hero_video: Plays silently on loop with a pause button. Replaces the image when set.
info.load_first: Turn on when this is the first section on the page, so the image loads quickly.
info.logo_social: Used in search results, social sharing and on the gift card page.
info.nested_menu: Supports three levels. Second level items become column headings, third level items are listed below them.
info.new_badge: Products tagged new always show the New badge. Products published within this many days also show it. Set to 0 to use the tag only.
info.newsletter: Sign-ups are added to your customer list with the newsletter tag.
info.rail_menu: Optional row of pill links under the header, for example Women, Men, Kids, Sport.
info.related: Recommendations are made automatically. Adjust them in the Search and Discovery app.
info.social: Add your links in Theme settings, Social media.
info.swatches: Colour swatches use the colours and images set on your product option values.
info.image_collection: Used when no image is chosen. Shows the collection image, or its first product image.
info.tab_source: Materials uses the masgouf.materials, custom.material and masgouf.care metafields, then the Materials and Care sections of the description. Fit uses masgouf.fit_notes, then the Fit section. Shipping uses the Shipping section and links your shipping and refund policies.
info.tab_content: Your own text for this tab. When the product has no content of its own, this text is shown, and if it is empty a built-in default is used.
info.contact_form: Messages are sent with Shopify to your store sender email. Spam protection is handled by Shopify.
info.email_required: Email is always required, so Shopify can send the message. If you remove this block, an email field is still shown first.
info.info_menu: For example links to your FAQ, shipping and returns pages.
info.navigator: The navigator opens your menu as an index with image tiles. On phones it is always the menu.
info.hide_first_item: A first menu item that only repeats the navigator, such as Shop, is hidden automatically.
info.transparent_home: The header turns solid as soon as the shopper scrolls.
info.announcement_speed: For the fade and marquee modes. Moving messages always have a pause button and stay still for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.
info.dismissible: Closed bars stay hidden until the browser tab is closed.
info.schemes: Six schemes come ready: 1 Paper, 2 Ink, 3 Sand, 4 Sage, 5 Blush, 6 High contrast. Style presets change all of them at once.
info.policies: Lists every policy you have filled in under Settings, Policies.
info.footer_menu: If this menu is empty, the footer menu is used, then your common pages and blog.
info.style_intro: Ready-made choices for the whole store. Pick one, then fine-tune colours, fonts and corners further down if you like.
info.palette: Replaces colour schemes 1 and 3. Choose Custom to edit every scheme yourself.
info.font_pairing: The ready pairs use fonts already on the shopper's device, so nothing extra downloads. The Arabic pair reads well in Arabic. Custom uses the font pickers in Typography.
info.animations: Reveal on scroll, image zoom and drawer motion. Shoppers who ask their device for reduced motion never see movement.
info.corner_radius: Used when Style > Corners is set to Custom.
info.search_popular: Separate searches with commas. Shown on the search page, in the search overlay and when nothing is found.
info.suggested_collection: Leave empty to show your newest products.
info.search_popular_where: Popular searches are set in Theme settings > Search.
info.logo_position: For the inline, centred and minimal layouts. The split, editorial and side layouts always centre the logo.
info.text_logo: Shown when no logo image is chosen. Leave empty to use the store name.
info.colour_gallery: Images are matched by alt text ending in "in [colour]", for example "Coffee tin in navy". Without that, each colour variant's image starts its group. Products without colour data show all images.
info.show_per_page: Shows a 12, 24, 36 or 48 per page choice. The choice is remembered in a hidden cart attribute.
info.show_arrows_rail: Arrows appear only when the row has more products than fit on screen.
info.hours_text: Short line above the heading, for example: Open today, 7:00 to 18:00. Leave empty to hide it.
info.board_products: Leave empty to use the collection below, or your newest products.
info.board_collection: Used when no products are chosen. Also adds a View all link to the board.
info.menu_category: Leave empty to use your store collections in order. The title is optional and replaces the collection title.
info.bake_product: Optional. Links the line to a product and uses its title when Item name is empty.
info.ingredients_product: Leave empty to use the first product in stock.
info.ingredients_heading: Leave empty to use the product title.
info.ingredients: Leave empty to use the product metafield masgouf.ingredients (multi-line text).
info.ingredients_image: Leave empty to use the product image.
info.allergens: Add one Allergen block per allergen. With no blocks, the product metafield masgouf.allergens (list of single line text) is shown under Contains. Check every entry against your product labels.
info.visit_address: Leave empty to use the store address from your Shopify settings.
info.map_link: A link to your shop on a map service. Opens in a new tab.
info.food_metafields: Food details read product metafields in the masgouf namespace: ingredients, allergens, dietary, may_contain, nutrition, nutrition_basis, serving_size, servings, net_weight, pieces, delivery_days, fresh_note, storage, shelf_life, recipe, recipe_article and pairing. Each block lists what it uses.
info.larder_heading: Shown above the blocks whose placement is Below the photos.
info.subscriptions: Purchase options appear only when the product has selling plans from a subscription app.
info.ingredients_block: Reads masgouf.ingredients (multi-line text), masgouf.allergens and masgouf.dietary (lists of text) and masgouf.may_contain. Without metafields it uses a description part headed Ingredients, then product tags such as allergen:nuts and diet:vegan.
info.single_product_fallback: Shown when the product has no metafield for this. Only use it on a template made for one product, so other products never show the wrong food information.
info.nutrition_block: Reads masgouf.nutrition (multi-line text). One row per line: Name | amount | amount per serving. Start a line with - for a sub-row such as - of which sugars.
info.serving_block: Reads masgouf.net_weight, masgouf.pieces, masgouf.servings and masgouf.serving_size (text). Variant metafields win over product metafields. Updates when the variant changes.
info.freshness_block: masgouf.delivery_days (list of day names) replaces the days below. Also reads masgouf.fresh_note, masgouf.storage and masgouf.shelf_life.
info.pairing_block: Reads masgouf.recipe (text), masgouf.recipe_article (article) and masgouf.pairing (list of products). Without them it uses the settings below.
info.tab_source_food: Storage reads masgouf.storage or a description part headed Storage. Delivery reads a description part headed Delivery or Shipping. Auto picks one from the heading.
info.related_food: Shopify picks related products over time. Until then, products from the same collection are shown.
info.collection_banner_image: Uses the collection image, or the first product photo when the collection has no image.
info.banner_note: A short line shown as a label, for example: Baked every morning.
info.cart_heading: Leave empty to use the default title.
info.suggestions_collection: Leave empty to show the newest products.
info.show_print: Lets shoppers print a recipe. Header, footer and comments are left out of the print.
info.sign_note: Short line on the stall sign. Leave empty for the theme text.
info.baking_days: Day codes separated by commas: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.
info.hand_font: Used for prices and notes on the chalk boards.
info.free_delivery_threshold: Use the same amount as the free rate in Settings, Shipping and delivery. The cart shows how much more is needed. Leave empty to hide the bar.
info.free_delivery_countries: Two letter country codes separated by commas, for example US,CA. Leave empty when free delivery applies everywhere.
info.contact_email: Shown on the contact page. Leave empty to show only the contact form.
info.meta_description: Used when the store has no home page description in Online Store, Preferences. Other pages use their own description, then a short line made from their title.
info.info_email: Leave empty to use the store contact email from the theme settings (Brand assets). When both are empty, only the form is shown.
info.mg_tabs_menu: When the store has no filter that can be tabs, the first menu item with sub-items gives the tabs.
info.mg_chip_hints: One per line, the collection handle then a short hint, for example bakery: 6:30
info.mg_search_featured: Shown as menu lines in the search ticket before the shopper types. Empty shows the first products of the store.
info.mg_stall_photo: Used by the awning shape. A wide photo works best.
info.mg_map_photo: A wide photo of the stall or the market. Without blocks, every collection gets a pin along the counter; add Pin blocks to place them yourself.
info.mg_about: Without Story blocks, the page content is split at its headings into rows, and Photo blocks fill the round plates in order.
info.mg_faq: Each h2 heading in the page content is a question; the text under it is the answer.
